items.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about mould remediation

faqs.question: Do you intervene after water damage?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mould files are often related to infiltration, water damage or residual humidity left in the building.

faqs.question: What are the typical signs of a mould problem?
faqs.answer: Common signs include a musty odour, staining on walls or ceilings, moisture-damaged materials and areas that did not dry properly after a leak or infiltration.

faqs.question: Can you work in attics, basements or bathrooms?
faqs.answer: Yes. These are common mould-prone areas because of humidity, condensation, ventilation issues or water infiltration.

faqs.question: Can you remove the affected materials?
faqs.answer: Yes. We remove contaminated materials and prepare the area for the next stage of work.

faqs.question: Do some files require sampling or air testing?
faqs.answer: Yes, depending on the situation. When contamination is not fully visible, uncertain or needs better documentation, sampling can help confirm the right sequence of intervention.

faqs.question: Do you cover Gatineau, Ottawa and Quebec City?
faqs.answer: Yes. We serve Gatineau, Ottawa and Quebec City depending on the project.
